scripts.build: vite build --mode development && vite build -c vite.sw.config.ts --mode development && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode development && CONTENT_TARGET=outlook vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode development
scripts.build:prod: vite build --mode production && vite build -c vite.sw.config.ts --mode production && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode production && CONTENT_TARGET=outlook vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode production
scripts.package: pnpm build:prod && rm -f aziru-extension.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../aziru-extension.zip .
scripts.build:firefox: EXT_BROWSER=firefox vite build --mode development && EXT_BROWSER=firefox vite build -c vite.sw.config.ts --mode development && EXT_BROWSER=firefox vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode development && EXT_BROWSER=firefox CONTENT_TARGET=outlook vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode development
scripts.build:prod:firefox: EXT_BROWSER=firefox vite build --mode production && EXT_BROWSER=firefox vite build -c vite.sw.config.ts --mode production && EXT_BROWSER=firefox vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode production && EXT_BROWSER=firefox CONTENT_TARGET=outlook vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode production
scripts.package:firefox: pnpm build:prod:firefox && rm -f aziru-extension-firefox.zip && cd dist-firefox && zip -r ../aziru-extension-firefox.zip .
scripts.dev: rm -rf dist && concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail -n panel,sw,gmail,outlook -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "vite build --watch --mode development" "vite build -c vite.sw.config.ts --watch --mode development" "vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development" "CONTENT_TARGET=outlook vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development"
scripts.dev:firefox: rm -rf dist-firefox && concurrently -k --kill-others-on-fail -n panel,sw,gmail,outlook -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "EXT_BROWSER=firefox vite build --watch --mode development" "EXT_BROWSER=firefox vite build -c vite.sw.config.ts --watch --mode development" "EXT_BROWSER=firefox vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development" "EXT_BROWSER=firefox CONTENT_TARGET=outlook vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development"
scripts.dev:content:outlook:firefox: EXT_BROWSER=firefox CONTENT_TARGET=outlook vite build --watch -c vite.content.config.ts --mode development
